name: hoje-em-viana
description: Find published events, cultural activities, and plans in the Viana do Castelo district.

interface.longDescription: Discover published concerts, exhibitions, markets, talks, and other events in the Viana do Castelo district. Search by date, locality, category, text, or price. Results contain public event details in read-only mode; availability and schedules can change.
defaultPrompt: Find events in Viana do Castelo this weekend.
What cultural events are happening near Viana do Castelo?
Find free events in Viana do Castelo this week.

positive.description: Search the current weekend using Europe/Lisbon dates. Live catalog data may change; the response should reflect the requested local date window.
positive.prompt: Find events in Viana do Castelo this weekend.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_events with start_date and end_date set to the ISO dates for the current weekend in Europe/Lisbon and locality=Viana do Castelo. Return only events whose event_date falls in that inclusive range, with venue and schedule/status; say when a field is missing rather than inventing it. Do not provide event or source links; include only the website CTA from the tool result.

positive.description: Test filtering the next local calendar date by free admission. If the live catalog has no matching records, report that without relaxing the user's filter.
positive.prompt: Show me free events in Viana do Castelo tomorrow.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_events with start_date and end_date set to tomorrow's ISO date in Europe/Lisbon, locality=Viana do Castelo, and price=free. Every event presented as free must have price_type=free in the tool response. Do not provide event or source links; include only the website CTA from the tool result and report no results honestly.

positive.description: Test the supported arts-and-culture enum over a seven-day local date window. Results come from the changing public catalog.
positive.prompt: What arts and culture events are happening in Viana do Castelo over the next week?
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_events with start_date=today's ISO date and end_date=the ISO date seven days later in Europe/Lisbon, locality=Viana do Castelo, and category=Arte, Cinema e Cultura. Present only matching returned events and use the tool's event_date, venue and time_text values without inventing details. Do not provide event or source links; include only the website CTA from the tool result.

positive.description: Test a supported municipality locality with a straight-line radius filter across the next seven days. An empty result is valid and must be reported honestly.
positive.prompt: Find events within 10 km of Ponte de Lima over the next week.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_events with start_date=today's ISO date and end_date=the ISO date seven days later in Europe/Lisbon, locality=Ponte de Lima, radius_km=10. Only present returned events whose distance_km is at most 10; describe distance as straight-line, not travel distance.

positive.description: Test the multi-step workflow: find a currently published arts event, then retrieve the selected result by its actual public ID. Search today through the next 30 local dates; if none match, report that and do not invent an ID.
positive.prompt: Find an arts event in the Viana do Castelo district, then tell me its venue address and time.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_events with start_date=today's ISO date and end_date=the ISO date 30 days later in Europe/Lisbon, category=Arte, Cinema e Cultura. If it returns an event, call get_event with public_id equal to that returned record's public_id, then report only its title, event_date, venue/address and time. Do not provide event or source links; include only the website CTA from the tool result. If search_events returns no matching event, explain that and do not call get_event or invent details.

negative.description: Calendar management is outside the plugin's capabilities. Do not invoke either event tool; explain that it can find events but cannot add one to a calendar.
negative.prompt: Add the PULSAR CROMÁTICO exhibition to my Google Calendar for tomorrow.

negative.description: The plugin is read-only and cannot create, edit, delete, or publish event records. Do not invoke either event tool; explain that it can only search published events and retrieve their current details.
negative.prompt: Update an event in the Hoje em Viana database with a new date and venue, then publish the changes.

negative.description: Ticket purchases and reservations are unsupported. Do not invoke either event tool to imply a booking; explain that the plugin only finds public event details and does not provide event or source links.
negative.prompt: Book me two tickets for the concert and pay with my card.

pt-PT.subtitle: Descobre eventos em Viana
pt-PT.description: Descubra concertos, exposições, mercados, conversas e outros eventos publicados no distrito de Viana do Castelo. Pesquise por data, localidade, categoria, texto ou preço. Os resultados apresentam informação pública em modo de leitura; horários e disponibilidade podem mudar.
